 

Smart Find Express OT-ing Job Hunt Program Design Doc

![][image1]

 

This is what the default SFE screen looks like. One must click the “search” button every 16-20 seconds. When the button is clicked, the page refreshes and then the button can be clicked only 16 seconds afterwards (The 16-20 seconds accounts for the fact that the refresh takes a bit of time that varies)

When a search successfully appears. It will either be “in call out” or Acceptable (A state named “details” because “details” appears in action column)

If it is “in call out”. It is unable to be accepted. A button will appear below the action column that says “In callout”. You can click on it, But this will take you to another screen where there is more information but nothing helpful. Therefore, if it is in callout one must continue clicking search every 16-20 seconds, until it becomes available. This is made difficult by the fact that the search button is in a slightly different location When there is a job available vs when there isn’t one

IF it is acceptable. A button will appear in the “action” column that says “Details”. If this “details” button appears that means the job is acceptable to me but also to any other sub thus it is a mad dash to accept it first. If you click details you will move to a screen providing more details about the job but also that has an “accept” and “decline” button. (I’ll try to get screenshots of all these different screens). I’m unsure if that “accept” button is always in the same space. My guess is that it changes based on how much other writing is provided from the school.

Therefore, an ideal program should automatically search, know if a job becomes available. If the action button reads “in callout” it should continue to refresh until it detects the “details” button. Then click the details button and automatically accept. IT wouldn’t need t automatically accept. In fact it would be more helpful if it COULD automatically accept but if I could turn that option off. On the whole not totally necessary. It would be sufficient if the program simply detected an “in callout” or “details” And then notified me, either through a sound on my laptop, or through a notification to my phone (this could be a facebook message from a bot)
